source_name: old.bank.gov.ua legacy register archive (e.g. Довідник підрозділів небанківських фінустанов з генеральними ліцензіями на обмін валют)
why_relevant: NBU's legacy site still serves historical register snapshots and directories (currency-exchange general licences, older bank lists) that were dropped in the site migration. Valuable for back-filling time series of the regulated population and for reconstructing when entities entered or left the market.

source_name: YouControl — commercial register-aggregation and company dossier platform
why_relevant: Aggregates 130+ Ukrainian state registers into company dossiers with change-tracking and affiliation graphs, including paid EDR API access, court decisions, financial statements and sanctions lists. Useful as a resilience layer when state registers are restricted, and as a shortcut for ownership structure behind PSPs and processors.

source_name: Opendatabot — register-monitoring service and API (incl. own PEP register)
why_relevant: Monitors hundreds of thousands of companies daily across the main Ukrainian state registers and maintains its own PEP register and sanctions-exposure screening. A practical change-detection alternative to polling state registers directly, and a cross-check on register freshness.

source_name: Clarity Project — procurement and counterparty analytics over 130+ registers
why_relevant: Cross-register analytics platform built on Prozorro plus 130+ state registers. Reveals banks and PSPs indirectly through their state-contract relationships (e.g. acquiring, cash-handling and terminal supply tenders), which is exactly the 'reveals-indirectly' category for enumerating market participants not visible in NBU registers.

source_name: НАБУ — Незалежна/Національна асоціація банків України (official site)
why_relevant: Largest Ukrainian banking association (members hold >95% of banking-system assets per its own description). Primary counterparty in NBU and Verkhovna Rada consultations; publishes association positions, committee work and member-facing summaries of regulatory change. Bilingual (ua/ru) URL trees exist.

source_name: НАБУ — Вихідні листи НАБУ (outgoing letters to regulators)
why_relevant: This is the single highest-value page in the cell: the association's formal outgoing correspondence to the NBU, Verkhovna Rada committees and ministries — i.e. the actual consultation submissions and objections to draft resolutions, usually with dates and document references.

source_name: НАБУ — «Традиційний моніторинг змін у фінсекторі за тиждень»
why_relevant: Weekly plain-language digest of financial-sector regulatory change written FOR member banks. Exactly the 'upcoming deadlines summarised for members' artefact the cell rationale targets; numbered URL series (…-3, -39, -62, -68, -72, -74) means a stable, enumerable archive and downloadable PDFs.

source_name: НАБУ — фінансовий моніторинг (committee page: proposals, laws)
why_relevant: Thematic committee landing page aggregating the association's AML/financial-monitoring proposals and the underlying laws. Useful for mapping which NABU committee owns which regulatory file (committees identified: regulatory compliance & currency supervision; payment technologies, information security & payment fraud prevention; legal support of banks' activity & creditor rights).

source_name: ЄМА — Законодавство (legislative dossiers by topic)
why_relevant: Verified by fetch: eight longitudinal legislative dossiers (PSD2 2015-2024; amendments to the Payment Systems law 2002-2021; interchange/IRF; terminalisation & card acceptance 2004-2024; credit bureaus & NBU registry; Criminal Code amendments on cashless payments; zero liability; fiscal incentives for cashless). Tracks both draft laws and NBU resolutions with the association's own documents attached. Paginated (page 2 exists).

source_name: ЄМА — Новини платіжного ринку від ЄМА (payment-market news series)
why_relevant: Recurring numbered digest ('Новини платіжного ринку від ЄМА -16' etc.) aggregating payment-market and regulatory developments for members — the payments analogue of NABU's weekly monitoring, and a good deadline early-warning feed.

source_name: ЄМА — Члени асоціації (member list)
why_relevant: Member roster = map of the banks, PSPs, processors and vendors active in Ukrainian payments. Per the cell rationale this is the pointer into the private-sector ecosystem whose procurement never appears on public portals.

source_name: ЄМА — AntiFraud HUB / Security Forum (payment fraud self-regulation)
why_relevant: EMA's AntiFraud HUB, EMA Academy, Payment Council meetings and Security Forum are the venues where supervisory expectations on payment fraud are negotiated and translated into member practice — an indirect but high-signal read on where NBU supervision is heading on fraud/security requirements.

source_name: Асоціація українських банків (АУБ / AUB) — official site
why_relevant: The oldest Ukrainian banking association (founded 1990). Works to have its зауваження/пропозиції taken into account by Verkhovna Rada committees and the government on draft legislative and normative acts on banking. Not named in the cell brief but is a first-order consultation counterparty alongside NABU and must be covered.

source_name: AUB English press centre — Financial Sector News & Expert Opinion
why_relevant: Verified by fetch: AUB maintains a full English mirror with dated items summarising NBU regulatory changes (e.g. SEP/banking-system year-end operation rules for 2026, insurer solvency requirements, March EU-alignment of banking regulation). Rare English-language association channel — makes deadline extraction cheap and cross-checkable against the Ukrainian original.

source_name: AUB — Analytics / AUB Analytics / Expert Opinion
why_relevant: AUB's own analytical output, including expert commentary on NBU measures (e.g. reinstated bank requirements and updated currency regulation). Association-authored interpretation of supervisory change, i.e. the 'what this means for members' layer.

source_name: AUB — Members list and statutory documents
why_relevant: Member roster + governing documents. Pointer to the bank universe represented in consultations; the AUB Statute is also registered in the state legal database (zakon.rada.gov.ua v0002697-95, 08.06.1995), giving a verifiable legal identity.

source_name: Меморандум про забезпечення прозорості функціонування ринку платіжних послуг (industry memorandum coordinated by AUB + NABU)
why_relevant: Textbook self-regulation artefact: banks, coordinated by the banking associations, signed and later (14 May 2026) updated a Memorandum setting common approaches to client work and transfer limits for ФОП/companies to counter illegal financial schemes. Sets de-facto compliance deadlines for members outside formal NBU regulation — high-value for the deadlines topic. Mirrored on both NABU and AUB sites.

source_name: Український кредитно-банківський союз (УКБС / UKBS)
why_relevant: Named in the cell brief. Collegial association reported to unite ~92 credit-financial institutions from all regions plus representative offices of foreign financial institutions; works specifically on legislative base and state regulation of banking. Documented as taking public regulatory positions (e.g. opposing a ban on contractual determination of penalty size).

source_name: Всеукраїнська асоціація фінансових компаній (ВАФК / VAFK)
why_relevant: Non-bank financial companies association; an Open API Group participant and an active interpreter of NBU rules for members. Its site carries dated 'what changes from July', prudential-requirements and collector-sanctions explainers plus a dedicated Законодавство and Правила taxonomy — strong deadline material for the payments/non-bank side.

source_name: FinTech Committee, IT Ukraine Association
why_relevant: A second, tech-industry route into fintech regulatory advocacy; relevant where regulation touches IT service providers and outsourcing rather than licensed institutions. English-language, useful cross-check on fintech positions.

source_name: Ukrainian Interbank Payment Systems Member Association "EMA" — LinkedIn
why_relevant: Confirms EMA's official English name and self-description (represents members before the NBU, Cabinet and Parliament on card programmes, card-business legal/technological issues and cashless payments) — useful for entity resolution and English-language alias mapping. Low collection value: small following, and LinkedIn scraping is restricted.

source_name: Open Banking Ukraine ecosystem portals (openbanking.com.ua, Open API Hub)
why_relevant: Ecosystem portals around the association-driven open-banking standard; act as pointers to participating banks/TPPs, published API specifications and implementation timelines that follow from the OAG/NBU process.

source_name: Wikipedia (uk) entity pages for the associations
why_relevant: Cheap entity-resolution layer: settles the NABU naming ambiguity (Незалежна vs Національна асоціація банків України — the association itself uses both across its own page titles) and the AUB/UKBS founding facts and aliases. Also disambiguates from the unrelated НАБУ = Національне антикорупційне бюро України, a serious query-noise trap.

source_name: PwC Ukraine Tax & Legal Alert — NBU regulatory updates (association-adjacent professional digest)
why_relevant: Not an association, but the professional-services digest that association members actually read and that VAFK co-hosts webinars with. Bundles per-period NBU changes for banks, financial companies, payment institutions, insurers and collection agencies with effective dates — an excellent English cross-check on association deadline claims.

source_name: U.S.-Ukraine Business Council (USUBC) — Ukraine regulatory notices
why_relevant: A foreign business association republishing NBU draft-regulation notices in English. Useful as an English-language mirror of consultation launches and as a pointer to the international-business counterparties in Ukrainian consultations.

source_name: ЮРЛІГА / LIGA:ZAKON — association regulatory-position coverage
why_relevant: Legal-news publisher that reports association objections to draft acts in detail (documented example: UKBS opposing a ban on contractual penalty determination) and hosts the consolidated texts of the underlying laws (e.g. Про платіжні системи та переказ коштів). Essential fallback where an association's own site is unreachable — notably UKBS.

source_name: Каталог фінтех-компаній України (Fintech companies catalogue, association-produced)
why_relevant: Association-produced directory of Ukrainian fintech companies, redistributed via a Ukrainian MFA embassy site. A ready-made map of the non-bank payments ecosystem — private companies whose procurement and vendor relationships never surface on public portals.

source_name: PrivatBank — News & press releases archive (Новини та прес-релізи)
why_relevant: Ukraine's largest (state-owned but market-dominant) bank publishes customer-facing announcements including service/limit/tariff changes; frequently the first observable signal that an NBU rule is being implemented and from what date.
